result.topic_en: Notes on the foundations of multiplication of whole numbers: commutativity and associativity of products, the order of factors in a product of many factors, and the definition and transitivity of divisibility.

methods.what: Commutativity and associativity of multiplication for three factors, via product defined as repeated summation of a
Commutativity derived from the special case a=1
Extension of associativity to four factors
Arbitrary reordering of factors in a product of many factors reduced to the three-factor case
Definition of divisor (including the trivial case m=b)
